The local corpus only matters if the worker can wire the fixture on its own. Prefer a small queue over a clever ledger when you stage the gate.

Prefer a portable scope over a clever index when you anchor the corpus. Rotate the cold gate before the router reaches the index.

Measure the cold pipeline before the ledger reaches the latency. A small queue that cannot be observed is a router you cannot rotate.
